title: Types of Entrepreneurship

alignment.course_outcome: CO1 - Discuss the fundamentals of entrepreneurship

template_credit: Sidebar tabs interaction template by David

illustration.subject: Five distinct entrepreneur archetypes positioned along a spectrum from pioneering change to resisting change, with a modern social-technology venture at the end
illustration.composition: Horizontal character and venture spectrum with varied postures and tools, no written labels
illustration.style: Colour-block editorial character illustration with clean silhouettes and technical details

case: Case connection: Greenviro Global can be discussed as innovative, environmentally oriented and locally grounded; one venture may fit more than one defensible classification.
misconception: Common mistake: Treating entrepreneur types as permanent personality labels or assuming imitative entrepreneurship has no innovation.
application: Classify a local service or manufacturing venture using both a functional type and a modern form.

sources.locator: Unit I, I.3 Types of entrepreneurship
sources.use: Functional and modern classifications, case and cautions

sources.use: Innovative, imitative, Fabian and drone classifications
